integrity_statement: The mathematical arguments and finite verifier are included in full. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact statements cover odd integers whose prime factors are in {3,5,7}; the conjecture for all odd integers is not resolved. Harrington–Jones 2010 full text was not accessible during comparison. Finite verification does not replace the proof.
title: Exact heights and sharp extremizers of the second Schemmel totient on the 7-smooth odd integers
